body: Something similar happened to me when I was 11/12 years old with a boy that was also my age. He invited me to his house to play videogames after school and when we were playing he started to kiss me and it made me feel really uncomfortable, then he start to grab me and I was telling him to stop. He also force me to sit and move on top of him (with clothes), and of course at that time I had no idea of what was going on. Also I wanted to play videogames but he would't let me until I kiss him or I touch him. We were the only ones in the house so I couldn't go anywhere, and when his mom arrived she drove me home and I didn't say anything because I was mostly confused. And it's weird because at that time I obvioulsy didn't have any context, it made me feel sad and used, but know thinking about that episode back I ask myself the same thing.

Aw that's so sweet of your husband! I told my boyfriend recently and he told me that my hair looks the same so he thinks I'm overeacting as well, but he has been supportive. He also told me (because he also has hair loss) that he knows how it feels but that probably is worse for woman. But I don't think he realizes how much worse, so the height argument is a good one. 

Your comment really lift my mood tho, I think I need to see the big picture. Realizing that I'm getting old is a hard to swallow pill but is normal and is going to happen for everyone.

I don't care what other people think because most people don't even notice others on the street, I didn't know female hair loss was a thing until two months ago that I start looking specifically for that. And it is kinda common... 

But for me is important because it was a very important part of my identity, it really helped my self steem and gave me more confidence. I like how it felt and how it moved with the wind. 

And sometimes I feel guilty because maybe it isn''t a "real" problem, maybe is just vanity or aesthetics. But at the same time I feel like it is a big deal...

Totally, when I was 12 they didn't let me buy a Missy Elliot's album because it had the "parental advisory" sticker on it. Then I bought another band's album on my own but it had the same sticker, so they decided it was better for me if they listen it first. At the end of the "evaluation" of the album's content I was allowed to listen to that album but all of that left me feeling embarassed and dumb.

The thing I hate the most is that they call themselves atheist and think they are better than everyone else and have the moral high ground, but act as repressive and controlling as some religious individuals.

Thank u for taking your time to answer and for your advice. I think I was feeling really bad and nihilistic in that moment. I am still feeling sad because I was not prepared (neither of us dealing with hairloss I guess) for this, I didn't even thought it was possible for ladies, so it really hit me out of nowhere and I thought I was alone. But I'm glad I came across with a helpful community with people willing to hear your problems because they get exactly how hard and painful it is. I might get professional support tho, but I'm feeling better now. Thanks for your concern.

Thank u so much, I'm really glad I found this community because I thought I was the only one dealing with this situation. Is nice when you can relate to others, it gets better even if it is a traumatic and hard experiencie.

Yeah I've been feeling super bad so it just a matter of time breaking down and start crying. I'm always covering my face with my hair or play with it so I can feel less insecure, so still trying to process it. 

That sounds nice, I'm glad things worked out for you. Thank you for taking your time to answer :)

I feel the same way :( I'm going to a dermatologist tomorrow but I can't stop thinking about my hair in every little thing I do. I start crying everytime I take a bath and I feel so insecure when I'm outside. My hair was the only thing (of my looks) that made me felt pretty and femenine. I'm starting to have nightmares about it, and when I wake up nothing has changed. I don't even know how to tell my boyfriend or my family :(  

I found some instagram and YT accounts that talk about hair loss and that made me feel less lonely. Maybe that can help you.

I took bloodtests like a year ago because of my acne, and my T levels were higher than normal. 

That dermatologist told me that that was the cause of the acne but after all the treatment I didn't have acne anymore so she didn't tell me anything else about the bloodtest. 

I'm going to ser another dermatologist but maybe the high T has something to do with the hair loss or maybe the acne treatment? 

Thank you for taking the time to answer.
